## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

For sizes 2x2, 2x3, 3x3, 3x4, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 6x8 and 8x8, F2 row reduction gives dim H1 = (E - rank d1) - rank d0 = 0 (disk), 1 (cylinder), 2 (torus), agreeing with (2 if closed else 1) minus the Euler characteristic, with d1 d0 = 0.

### Governing Obligation
Fixed sizes only; a closed-form proof for all rows and cols is absent.

### Witness Audit
Evidence is the Rust rank computation and its cross-language JSON fixture. Lean torus/cylinder/disk_h1_dimension are rfl on an enum, and the paper evaluator's TetronCarrier.h1_dim is a hard-coded label per topology, so the Python test does not measure homology.
